74.description: This feature vector represents common suffixes and syllables in Hindi text.

147.description: This vector represents Hindi text fragments, vowel signs, and common inflectional suffixes.

189.description: These tokens represent common Hindi vowel modifiers, nasalization markers, and conjunct consonant combinations typical of Devanagari script text.

82.description: This feature vector represents sub-word tokens and character fragments from various Indic scripts.

119.description: This vector activates for conjunct consonants and specialized phonetic characters in various scripts.

72.description: This feature vector represents the anusvara diacritic and nasal consonant clusters in the Devanagari script.

121.description: This feature vector represents Hindi interrogative and conditional adverbial markers expressing time, place, and circumstance.

135.description: This feature vector represents common Hindi vowel sign characters attached to punctuation marks or commas.

144.description: These tokens represent fragments and characters of the Devanagari script used for writing Indo-Aryan languages like Hindi and Sanskrit.

186.description: These tokens represent character sequences, subwords, or common graphemes frequently occurring in Hindi text written in the Devanagari script.
